description: A shell script to install a CA certificate into the Java trust store, including functions for downloading, deleting, and installing the certificate, as well as determining the trust store location based on JAVA_HOME.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a command, printing a separator line before and after.

methods.name: printMessage
methods.description: Prints a message with separator lines before and after.

methods.name: determineTrustStoreOrKeyStoreLocation
methods.description: Determines the trust store location based on JAVA_HOME and sets the KEYSTORE variable.

methods.name: downloadCertificate
methods.description: Downloads the CA certificate from a specified URL.

methods.name: deleteDownloadedCertificate
methods.description: Deletes the downloaded CA certificate file.

methods.name: removeIfAlreadyInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is already installed and removes it if so.

methods.name: installCertificate
methods.description: Main function to determine trust store, download, remove existing cert, install new cert, and display keystore info.
